mobs.name: Void Dragon
mobs.notes: Purple-black void dragon; glowing violet eyes and wing membranes; heavy melee plus void breath.

mobs.name: Ender Overlord
mobs.notes: Floating multi-tentacled entity with a giant central violet eye; ranged void attacks and teleporting.

mobs.name: The End King
mobs.notes: Armored End ruler with crown, glowing purple cape, and large energy weapon.

mobs.name: Void Stalker
mobs.notes: Dark quadruped with violet crystal growths; fast melee predator.

mobs.name: Endermite Hive
mobs.notes: Cluster/hive of Endermite-like creatures; spawns or releases small attackers.

mobs.name: Purpur Golem
mobs.notes: Heavy purpur construct with glowing core; slow, durable melee attacker.

mobs.name: Shulker Beast
mobs.notes: Winged shulker-inspired predator; projectile attacks and aerial movement.

mobs.name: Void Wisp
mobs.notes: Ghostly violet flame creature; ranged projectile attacker.

mobs.name: End Spider
mobs.notes: Eight-legged End spider with glowing eyes; fast wall-climbing melee mob.

mobs.name: Corrupted Enderman
mobs.notes: Corrupted Enderman variant with violet cracks and particles; teleporting melee attacks.

mobs.name: Chorus Fiend
mobs.notes: Chorus-infused beast with purple growths; aggressive melee and short teleport.

mobs.name: Void Slime
mobs.notes: Dark cubic slime with bright violet core; jumps and splits if desired.

mobs.name: Teleporter
mobs.notes: Humanoid void caster surrounded by a teleport ring; attacks from range and repositions frequently.

mobs.name: End Crab
mobs.notes: Purple crystal crab with armored shell and strong claw attacks.

mobs.name: Obsidian Beast
mobs.notes: Massive horned obsidian animal covered in purple crystals; slow but very durable.

mobs.name: Ender Deer
mobs.notes: Elegant dark deer with cyan-violet antlers; calm until attacked.

mobs.name: Chorus Cow
mobs.notes: Cow covered in chorus growths; tameable livestock for a renewable meat source.

mobs.name: Void Hog
mobs.notes: Dark tusked hog with violet crystal spikes; tameable livestock.

mobs.name: Sky Ray
mobs.notes: Blue-violet manta/ray-like flying creature; tameable and rideable only if practical.

mobs.name: Ender Bird
mobs.notes: Purple-blue bird with bright cyan accents; tameable companion and renewable meat source.
